subject: [Invite] Encord Physical AI Leaders Dinner @ Taverna 2/26, PA
text:
Hi [NAME],

Our Co-Founder & Head of US will be hosting an intimate roundtable dinner with customers & AI leaders and we'd love for you to join.

We've booked a private dining room at Taverna: [LINK] in Palo Alto on Wednesday February 26th 6:30-9:30pm, capping attendance to ~25 people. Join us to connect & share perspectives with fellow AI leaders on key trends in the physical AI space.

Attendees in the past included CEO's, CTO's and Heads of AI/ML from companies like Nvidia, Adobe, Rhombus, Phillips, Etsy, Zebra, Pinterest and Instacart. We will also be joined by a few of our investors, including Next47 and CRV.

In case you're not familiar with Encord - we're an SF-based data development platform (recently raised our Series B: [LINK]) built to help computer vision teams get better models to market, faster.

Please RSVP to this invite to secure a spot, they are limited and on a first come, first served basis.

subject: Woven's data curation solution
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

We've recently onboarded Woven, so thought it may make sense to reach out to see if we can help at Renault in a similar way.

Woven's Computer Vision team faced challenges with existing data curation solutions (Voxel51 & internal tools), which lacked the speed & scalability required to efficiently search through their training datasets (capping out at ~1m images).

At Encord, we've built a high-performance architecture to support indexing and searching through billions of data items (using embeddings visualisations, quality metric filters & natural language searches), enabling CV teams to avoid bottlenecks in model development.

Open to learning more?

subject: Data development platform for Gen AI teams | RLHF, curation, annotation & model eval
text:
Hi [NAME],

Hope all's well! I'm reaching out because I see you're expanding your team
and we recently onboarded a couple teams like yours in the GenAI space as
they looked to scale & maximise the performance of their models (e.g.
multi-modal models & video generation), much like you at [COMPANY].

For a bit of context, Encord is an end-to-end data multimodal data
management platform for curation, annotation, RLHF and model evaluation. On
Gen AI Content Creation we work with the likes of Synthesia, Captions and
Twelve Labs.

Given your priorities at [COMPANY] and our experience with other leaders in
your space, thought it may be worthwhile we connect. Are you interested in
a quick call to chat through what we've been hearing from companies like
yours and provide more detail on where Encord tends to help?
